purpose: Step 4 of the QC methodology investigation: ask whether the independent COHERENCE_HOLDOUT program remains donor-consistent after tail and rest cells are compared only within overlapping Q_DEPTH/Q_DETECT support and are deterministically matched on those two QC axes.
authority: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. Not T0 science authority. Not training authority. Does not modify T0 V20, the frozen tail mask, the frozen QC veto, QC_ALPHA, the frozen target, the tail threshold, or either T0 terminal.
tail_grouping: Use the exact frozen confirmation tail/rest labels from T0 V20. Never recompute membership from QC-adjusted, thinned, residualised, or otherwise modified scoring data.
qc_source: Exact per-cell Q_DEPTH and Q_DETECT already used by the frozen tail QC preflight.

common_support.rule: Within each donor and each QC metric separately, compute the observed tail range and rest range. The metric-specific overlap is [max(min_tail,min_rest), min(max_tail,max_rest)]. Retain only cells whose Q_DEPTH and Q_DETECT both lie inside both metric overlap intervals. No cell outside this observed rectangular intersection may enter matching or validation.
common_support.empty_or_invalid_overlap: Exclude that donor from the matched diagnostic and report the reason.

matching.transform: Within donor, transform each QC metric to pooled empirical midranks over the common-support cells and scale ranks to [0,1]. This uses no pathology and no holdout expression.
matching.distance: Squared Euclidean distance in the two-dimensional pooled-rank QC space.
matching.algorithm: Deterministic minimum-total-distance 1:1 bipartite matching without replacement between tail and rest cells in common support. Match exactly min(n_tail,n_rest) pairs; because rest is expected larger this normally matches every eligible tail cell once. Ties break by canonical stable-cell-key byte order.
matching.why_no_caliper: No distance threshold is introduced after seeing the data; empirical common support provides the no-extrapolation boundary and all pair distances are published.

donor_eligibility_for_holdout_test.rationale: Five tail cells and ten decision donors reuse the frozen tail-coherence support minima rather than choosing new support numbers from this result.

required: pre-match and post-match tail/rest means for Q_DEPTH and Q_DETECT
pre-match and post-match standardized mean differences for both metrics
number and fraction of tail/rest cells retained by common support
balance_reporting.gate: None. These are diagnostic balance measurements; no post-hoc rescue threshold is defined.

heldout_validation.features: Use only the exact COHERENCE_HOLDOUT addresses and the exact frozen discovery-derived scale and decision mask used in T0 V20/step 3. SCORING features entering validation must equal zero.
heldout_validation.vector: For each eligible donor, compute the matched-tail minus matched-rest mean log1p(CP10K) holdout vector, divide by the frozen discovery scale on decision-capable features, zero non-decision features, and L2-normalize exactly as the frozen coherence vector builder does.
heldout_validation.test: Apply the existing exact_common_direction_test to the eligible donor vectors. Report mean pairwise cosine, exact p, null maximum, leave-one-donor-out agreement, donor vectors/norms, and donor count.
heldout_validation.interpretation: Persistence of a donor-consistent held-out program after QC matching is evidence that the independent program is not explained solely by the observed tail/rest Q_DEPTH/Q_DETECT difference. Loss of coherence does not prove the tail artefactual. Neither result changes frozen T0 authority.

acceptance_checks: FROZEN_TAIL_MASK_EXACT: every input tail/rest label must equal the frozen T0 V20 grouping
NO_PATHOLOGY_READ: AT8 or other pathology values must not be loaded
ONE_TO_ONE_NO_REPLACEMENT: no cell may appear in more than one pair within a donor
interpretation_limits: This is a diagnostic of whether the held-out program survives observed-QC equalisation. It is not a new T0 adjudication rule and cannot rescue the frozen rare-tail terminal.
Matching controls only the two observed QC metrics Q_DEPTH and Q_DETECT. Unmeasured technical confounding can remain.
Common-support restriction changes the cell subset and therefore the estimand; report retention explicitly.
Do not choose a balance threshold, alternative matching method, caliper, donor subset, or holdout feature subset after seeing this result.
Do not residualise the scoring tail score or redefine the tail in this step.
required_outputs: machine-readable contract binding and provenance hashes
per-pair stable keys and QC distances
concise findings document with frozen authority unchanged
